notes:
# Blackline 0.15.141

* An emoji chosen while a message is being edited goes into the message being edited, not into the
  message bar. The picker was working out which box to write into by looking at what had the focus —
  and opening the picker puts the focus in the picker's own search field, so it always guessed the
  bar. It now remembers the box it was opened for.
* Pressing the emoji button a second time closes the picker while editing a message, and on a
  thread's reply box, the same way it always has on the message bar.
